body: As I watched the stranger continue his drone-like movements through my neighborhood, something caught my eye—a small, intricate painting hidden in plain sight on one of the houses. Intrigued, I felt a flutter of curiosity that pushed me forward towards the door. My heart raced as I hesitated only briefly before stepping inside, ready to explore the unexpected treasure hiding within the walls of my home.
